events.label: birth
events.text: John Plumbe born in Castle Caereinion, Powys, Wales.

evidence.quote: Plumbe was born in Castle Caereinion , Powys , Wales in 1809

events.text: Family moved to Philipsburg, Pennsylvania.

evidence.quote: The family moved to Philipsburg , Pennsylvania in 1821

events.text: Relocated to Wisconsin territory and became railroad advocate.

evidence.quote: About 1836 he relocated to the Wisconsin territory

events.text: Published Sketches of Iowa and Wisconsin in St. Louis.

evidence.quote: St . Louis : Chambers , Harris & Knapp , 1839

events.text: Took up photography after seeing an itinerant daguerreotypist's work.

events.text: Published instructions for Plumbe's patent daguerreotype apparatus in Boston.

events.text: Exhibited photographic work at American Institute fair, New York.
